CREATE VIEW "yunipals_ownership_35cdcb32_v3".base_metadata_scan AS
    SELECT 'base_metadata_v1'::text AS name,8453::integer AS chain_id,'0x98433df878e8c898cb907345c3a7756e5f72240f'::text AS contract_address,
      22224075::bigint AS deployment_block,f.block_number+1 AS next_block,f.block_number AS target_block,
      f.block_hash AS target_hash,f.block_hash AS last_scanned_hash,statement_timestamp() AS updated_at

CREATE VIEW "yunipals_ownership_35cdcb32_v3".base_metadata_event AS
    SELECT e.chain_id,e.address AS contract_address,e.transaction_hash,e.log_index,e.transaction_index,e.block_number,e.block_hash,
      e.name AS event_name,e.args::jsonb->>'tokenId' AS token_id,lower(e.args::jsonb->>'to') AS recipient,
      e.args::jsonb->'yunipal' AS traits
    FROM "unified_shadow_20261020_7e7375b0".canonical_event e CROSS JOIN "yunipals_ownership_35cdcb32_v3".base_metadata_frame(true) f
    WHERE e.source_id='metadata:base' AND e.chain_id=8453 AND e.address='0x98433df878e8c898cb907345c3a7756e5f72240f'
      AND e.abi_hash='0x10ed1bdc491b581039c80bfe1a53832615bda607560c998ad5202542cf9a4259' AND e.name IN('Mint','Update')
      AND e.block_number>=22224075::bigint AND e.block_number<=f.block_number
